Entries: These presence/absence data on fish species detections from metabarcoding at Calleguas Creek are organized as a matrix with samples/sites as rows and species as columns.  An entry of 1 means the species was detected at that site/sample.  A 0 means it was not detected.  The matrix was developed by summarizing information in the New_Estuary_Data.csv file.
The data are resampled to plot the cumulative richness detected from a particular sampling effort.  Doing this several times makes it possible to plot confidence limits around the estimate.
US Geological Survey, Western Ecological Research Center, c/o Marine Science Institute, University of California
